description_en: Queries the back-to-origin policies for the forwarding rule of a website
description_zh: 查询网站业务转发规则的回源策略
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-l7-rs-policy --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain example.com --real-servers 1.000.000.1 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeL7RsPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website to query.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query the domain names for which forwarding rules are configured
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的网站业务的域名。

> 域名必须已经配置过网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已经配置过网站业务转发规则的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: An array that consists of N addresses of origin servers to query. The maximum value of N is 200. You can specify up to 200 addresses
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的源站服务器地址列表。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个源站服务器地址
parameters.name: real_servers
